description: This topic covers the proper use and care of computers, laboratory rules, health and safety practices, protecting equipment from environmental hazards, and basic data safety measures.

mcq.questionText: Which device is used to protect a computer from sudden loss of power so that work can be saved before shutdown?
mcq.explanation: A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) gives temporary battery power during a blackout so the user can save work and shut down safely.

mcq.questionText: Why should food and drinks be kept away from computers in the laboratory?

options.text: They make the room smell nice
Spills can damage the keyboard and internal parts
They increase the speed of the computer

mcq.explanation: Liquids and food crumbs can enter the keyboard or system unit and cause short circuits or corrosion, damaging the computer.

mcq.questionText: What is the main purpose of a voltage stabilizer?

options.text: To keep the electrical voltage steady

mcq.explanation: A stabilizer regulates incoming electricity so that voltage fluctuations do not damage the computer's components.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is the correct sitting posture when using a computer?

options.text: Sitting upright with feet flat on the floor
Slouching far back in the chair

mcq.explanation: Sitting upright with feet flat on the floor and the back supported reduces strain on the back and neck.

mcq.questionText: What is the best way to protect data against accidental loss?
mcq.explanation: Regular backups keep extra copies of files so data can be restored if the original is lost or damaged.

mcq.questionText: Which program is used to detect and remove malicious software from a computer?
mcq.explanation: Antivirus software scans for, detects, and removes viruses and other malware that can harm files and the system.

mcq.questionText: Looking at a computer screen for many hours without breaks can mainly cause which health problem?
mcq.explanation: Staring at a screen for long periods tires the eyes, causing eye strain; taking regular breaks helps reduce it.

mcq.questionText: Why should computers be kept in a dust-free environment?

options.text: Dust can clog fans and cause overheating

mcq.explanation: Dust blocks vents and fans, preventing proper cooling and leading to overheating and component damage.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a good laboratory rule for computer safety?

options.text: Do not touch electrical sockets with wet hands
Cover the ventilation holes of the system unit

mcq.explanation: Water conducts electricity, so touching sockets with wet hands can cause electric shock; this is a key safety rule.

mcq.questionText: What is the purpose of using a strong password on a computer?

options.text: To prevent unauthorized access to data

mcq.explanation: A strong password keeps out unauthorized people, protecting the privacy and security of stored data.

mcq.questionText: Why is high moisture or humidity harmful to a computer?

options.text: It can cause rust and short circuits in components

mcq.explanation: Moisture can corrode metal parts and cause short circuits, damaging the electronic components of a computer.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following helps reduce the risk of fire in a computer laboratory?

options.text: Overloading one power socket with many devices

mcq.explanation: A fire extinguisher allows a fire to be put out quickly; the other options actually increase the risk of fire.

mcq.questionText: What should you do before cleaning the outside of a computer?

options.text: Switch it off and unplug it from power

mcq.explanation: Switching off and unplugging the computer prevents electric shock and damage while cleaning.

mcq.questionText: Repeated typing in a poor wrist position over a long time can lead to which condition?
mcq.explanation: Repetitive Strain Injury results from repeated movements and poor wrist posture; ergonomic positioning helps prevent it.

mcq.questionText: Which environmental practice helps reduce electronic waste?

options.text: Burning old equipment in the open

mcq.explanation: Recycling old parts safely reduces e-waste and prevents harmful materials from polluting the environment.

fib.questionText: A device that supplies temporary battery power during a blackout is called a _____.
fib.explanation: UPS stands for Uninterruptible Power Supply and protects against sudden power loss.

fib.questionText: Software that detects and removes viruses from a computer is called _____ software.
fib.explanation: Antivirus software protects a computer from malicious programs.

fib.questionText: Making an extra copy of your files in case the original is lost is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A backup allows lost or damaged data to be restored.

fib.questionText: The study of designing the workplace and equipment for comfort and safety is called _____.
fib.explanation: Ergonomics helps reduce health problems such as back pain and strain.

fib.questionText: A secret word or code used to prevent unauthorized access to a computer is called a _____.
fib.explanation: Passwords protect the security and privacy of stored data.

fib.questionText: A device that keeps the electrical voltage steady to protect the computer is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A stabilizer protects the computer from voltage fluctuations.

fib.questionText: Looking at a computer screen for too long without rest can cause eye _____.
fib.explanation: Eye strain is reduced by taking regular breaks from the screen.

fib.questionText: Particles in the air that can clog computer fans and cause overheating are called _____.
fib.explanation: Dust blocks ventilation and prevents proper cooling of the computer.

fib.questionText: Discarded computers and electronic devices are commonly known as electronic waste or _____.
fib.explanation: E-waste should be recycled properly to protect the environment.

fib.questionText: Computers should be protected from high _____ such as direct sunlight, because too much heat can damage components.
fib.explanation: Excess heat can cause components to overheat and fail.

tf.questionText: A UPS can keep a computer running for a short time during a power cut.
tf.explanation: A UPS provides battery power temporarily so work can be saved before shutting down.

tf.questionText: It is safe to eat and drink while working at a computer in the laboratory.
tf.explanation: Spills and crumbs can damage the keyboard and internal parts, so food and drinks should be kept away.

tf.questionText: Regular backups help you recover your data if the original files are lost.
tf.explanation: Backups are extra copies that can be restored when needed.

tf.questionText: Touching electrical sockets with wet hands is a safe practice in the computer laboratory.
tf.explanation: Water conducts electricity, so wet hands can cause a dangerous electric shock.

tf.questionText: Dust collecting inside a computer can cause it to overheat.
tf.explanation: Dust blocks fans and vents, reducing cooling and causing overheating.

tf.questionText: Using the same simple password like '1234' for everything is a strong security practice.
tf.explanation: Simple, repeated passwords are easy to guess; strong, unique passwords are safer.

tf.questionText: Sitting upright with feet flat on the floor is good posture for computer use.
tf.explanation: Good posture reduces back and neck strain during long computer use.

tf.questionText: You should unplug a cable by pulling on the cord rather than holding the plug.
tf.explanation: Pulling the cord can damage the cable; you should hold and pull the plug instead.

tf.questionText: High humidity and moisture have no effect on computer components.
tf.explanation: Moisture can cause rust and short circuits, damaging the components.

tf.questionText: Recycling old computers helps reduce harm to the environment.
tf.explanation: Proper recycling keeps harmful e-waste materials out of the environment.

hoq.questionText: A school's computer laboratory in an area with frequent power cuts keeps losing unsaved work and damaging some machines. Which combination of measures best addresses both problems?

options.text: Install antivirus software and use strong passwords
Use a UPS for each computer and a voltage stabilizer for the laboratory
Make daily backups and clean the screens
Improve sitting posture and reduce screen brightness

hoq.explanation: A UPS protects against loss of unsaved work during blackouts while a stabilizer guards machines against damaging voltage fluctuations.

hoq.questionText: A student backs up files daily but stores every backup on the same hard disk inside the same computer. Why is this backup strategy weak?

options.text: Backups should never be made daily
If the computer is stolen or the disk fails, both original and backup are lost together
Daily backups use too much electricity

hoq.explanation: Keeping backups in the same place as the originals means a single disaster destroys both; backups should be kept on separate media or off-site.

hoq.questionText: Workers in an office complain of back pain, sore wrists, and tired eyes after long hours at their computers. Which set of changes most directly targets all three complaints?

options.text: Install a stronger antivirus and longer passwords
Adjust chairs and desks for posture, position keyboards for wrists, and take regular screen breaks
Add more dust filters and a bigger UPS
Recycle the old computers and buy faster ones

hoq.explanation: Ergonomic adjustments to seating and keyboard position address back and wrist problems, while regular breaks relieve eye strain.
